draft_before_correction.instructions:
## Purpose
Analyze monthly gross retail sales trends.

## Workflow
Define the reporting window, calculate monthly gross revenue, compute zero-safe Month-over-Month (MoM) growth, visualize with a line chart, and summarize key observations.

## Business definitions
Metric: Gross Revenue (orders.revenue in USD). Grain: Order-level. Filters: orders.status = 'completed'. Time: Calendar month (chronological sort).

## Examples
Show monthly revenue as a line chart.
